newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya coffee eases on poor quality.
newsitem.headline: Kenya coffee eases on poor quality.

text.p: Kenyan coffee prices eased on average at the weekly auction in Nairobi on Tuesday, dragged down by poor quality coffee on offer, auction officials said.
"We're selling the leftovers (of the main crop)," one trader said.
Grade ABs averaged $394 per 50-kg compared to $428 last week while grade AAs sold at $408 from $438.
The Coffee Board of Kenya said it sold 34,840 60-kg bags of coffee compared to 35,027 bags sold last week.
